**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/01/04 (Wed) 01:57
- [FACT] User provided a link to a document: https://cdn.australianretirementtrust.com.au/library/media/pdfs/reports/sustainable-investment-report-21-22.pdf?rev=7f803132a1524c66a5cbc1b421bf6cf7
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant confirmed willingness to answer questions based on the provided document.
- [USER] User asked if the fund clearly states its vision, mission, or mandate on sustainable investment and requested details if yes.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant confirmed that the Australian Retirement Trust (ART) clearly states its vision, mission, and mandate on sustainable investment, aiming to create long-term value for members and society.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant detailed that ART's mission is to help members achieve retirement goals by considering ESG factors in investments.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant mentioned that ART's sustainable investment mandate incorporates ESG factors to manage risks and identify opportunities for sustainable long-term returns.
- [USER] User inquired if the fund sets overall targets/goals on sustainable investment or asset allocation in its vision/mission statement on ESG and requested details if yes.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant confirmed that ART has set specific targets for sustainable investment, aiming for a 100% sustainable investment portfolio by 2023 and achieving 75% as of June 2021.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant stated that ART aims for net-zero emissions across its investment portfolio by 2050 and will assess and report on the carbon footprint of its investments.
- [USER] User asked if there is a dedicated team established to coordinate ESG/SDG investments and where the team/head of ESG reports to, requesting details if yes.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant confirmed that ART has a dedicated Responsible Investment Team for ESG/SDG investments.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant stated that the head of ESG/SDG investments, the Responsible Investment Manager, reports directly to the Chief Investment Officer.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant explained the team's responsibilities, including integrating ESG considerations into investment processes and engaging with companies on ESG issues.
- [USER] User asked if the fund has put in place internal policies or guidelines regarding ESG/SDG integration and requested details if yes.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant confirmed that ART has internal policies and guidelines for ESG/SDG integration, including a Responsible Investment Policy.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant detailed that the Responsible Investment Policy outlines ART's approach to sustainable investing and expectations for investment managers regarding ESG considerations.
